CollegeName: Government Medical College Purnea
FundingSource: Health Department, Government of Bihar (Directorate of Medical Education)
Notes: New government medical college (inception 2023), affiliated to Aryabhatta Knowledge University (AKU), Patna, the state-run health/technical university for Bihar's government medical colleges.

CollegeName: Patna Medical College Patna
Notes: One of India's oldest medical colleges (1925), run by the Government of Bihar, affiliated to Aryabhatta Knowledge University.

CollegeName: Darbhanga Medical College Lehriasarai
Notes: Established 1946, run by Government of Bihar, affiliated to Aryabhatta Knowledge University.

CollegeName: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Patna
FundingSource: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India
Notes: AIIMS Patna is an Institute of National Importance created by Act of Parliament (AIIMS Amendment Act 2012), centrally funded and autonomous, not affiliated to any state university.

CollegeName: Nalanda Medical College Patna
Notes: Established 1970, run by Government of Bihar, affiliated to Aryabhatta Knowledge University.

CollegeName: Shri Krishna Medical College Muzzafarpur
Notes: Established 1970, run by Government of Bihar, affiliated to Aryabhatta Knowledge University.

CollegeName: Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College Bhagalpur
Notes: Established 1971, run by Government of Bihar, affiliated to Aryabhatta Knowledge University.

CollegeName: Anugrah Narayan Magadh Medical College Gaya
Notes: Established 1969/1970, run by Government of Bihar, affiliated to Aryabhatta Knowledge University.

CollegeName: Employees State Insurance Corporation Medical College Patna
FundingSource: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
Notes: Located at Bihta, Patna; run by ESIC, a central autonomous body under the Ministry of Labour & Employment, though affiliated to Bihar University of Health Sciences/AKU for the MBBS course.

CollegeName: Jannayak Karpoori Thakur Medical College & Hospital Madhepura
Notes: New government medical college inaugurated 2020, affiliated to Bihar University of Health Sciences / recognized by NMC as a state government institution.

CollegeName: Government Medical College Bettiah
FundingSource: Health Department, Government of Bihar (Directorate of Medical Education)
Notes: Government medical college established 2013, affiliated to Aryabhatta Knowledge University, part of Bihar's state government medical college expansion.

CollegeName: Vardhman Institute of Medical Sciences Pawapuri Nalanda
FundingSource: Health Department, Government of Bihar (Directorate of Medical Education)
Notes: Government medical college established 2013 in Pawapuri, Nalanda district, affiliated to Aryabhatta Knowledge University.

CollegeName: Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences Sheikhpura Patna
FundingSource: Government of Bihar (autonomous statutory institute under state legislature Act)
Notes: IGIMS is an autonomous institute (on the AIIMS pattern) created by an Act of the Bihar State Legislature and functions under the Government of Bihar; it is a deemed/statutory university for its own courses, not a central institution.

CollegeName: M G M Medical College Jamshedpur
Notes: Mahatma Gandhi Memorial (MGM) Medical College, established 1961, is one of the government medical colleges fully run by the state government (originally under Bihar, now Jharkhand since 2000), affiliated to Kolhan University.

CollegeName: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Deoghar
FundingSource: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India
Notes: AIIMS Deoghar was set up under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY) and is an Institute of National Importance, centrally funded and administered autonomously under MoHFW, GoI.

CollegeName: Shaheed Nirmal Mahto Medical College & Hospital Dhanbad
Notes: Formerly Patliputra Medical College and Hospital; run by the Government of Jharkhand, affiliated to Binod Bihari Mahto Koylanchal University; admissions coordinated via Jharkhand Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (JCECEB).

CollegeName: Rajendra Institute of Medical Sciences Ranchi
FundingSource: Government of Jharkhand (autonomous statutory institute under state Act)
Notes: RIMS Ranchi is an autonomous institute established under an Act of the (Bihar/now Jharkhand) state legislature, functioning under the Government of Jharkhand; affiliated to Ranchi University for degree purposes.

CollegeName: Palamu Medical College Palamu
Notes: New government medical college established 2019 (foundation laid 2017 along with Dumka and Hazaribagh colleges), also known locally as Medinirai Medical College; affiliated to Nilamber Pitamber University.

CollegeName: Hazaribagh Medical College Hazaribagh
Notes: New government medical college established 2019, foundation laid 2017; now officially renamed Sheikh Bhikhari Medical College.

CollegeName: Dumka Medical College Dighi Dumka
Notes: New government medical college established 2019, foundation laid 2017; now officially renamed Phulo Jhano Medical College and Hospital, affiliated to Sidho Kanhu Murmu University.
